name: session-search
description: Gives Claude a search over your past Claude Code sessions: it greps the raw transcripts on demand, with no index, no model calls and nothing added at session start

extraRoots.title: Extra transcript folders
extraRoots.description: More folders of session transcripts besides this install's own projects folder, separated by ;. For example another OS's: /mnt/c/Users/<you>/.claude/projects from WSL, or \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\<you>\.claude\projects from Windows

loadTools.title: Load tools up front
loadTools.description: Put both tools in every request's tool list instead of behind tool search (about 500 tokens per request instead of about 50)
